First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @bffbikes the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BFF Bikes Beginner/Intermediate Ride group ride

A casual no-drop cruise around the city for people who have never done a group ride. No experience needed. On the off weeks the shop's Endurance Ride goes 30–50 miles at 16–18 mph.
